title: Random Crews
summary: Draw random samples with sample(), make them reproducible with set.seed(), and read probability as a long-run proportion.
hints: `set.seed(2026)` goes on its own line *before* the draw. Then `sample(1:564, size = 10)` picks 10 different ID numbers.
A die can land on 6 twice, so rolls need `replace = TRUE`: `sample(1:6, size = 600, replace = TRUE)`.
`rolls == 6` is TRUE/FALSE for each roll, and `mean()` of TRUE/FALSE is the proportion TRUE: `mean(rolls == 6)`.
